categories.name: Covenants and commandments
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Trace recipients, obligations, promises, signs and stated purposes.

categories.name: Sabbath and rest
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Distinguish rest instructions, participants, purposes and contextual applications.

categories.name: Appointed feasts and convocations
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Distinguish each appointed time and its stated instructions and connections.

categories.name: Dietary laws and clean/unclean
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Identify criteria, blood/carcass instructions and conditions.

categories.name: Appearance and modesty
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Examine fringes, hair, beards, clothing and modesty without added rules.

categories.name: Prayer, worship and holiness
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Explain prayer, worship and holiness in their covenant settings.

categories.name: Marriage, family and lineage
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Distinguish obligations, prohibited relationships and inheritance contexts.

categories.name: Parents, children and vulnerable people
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Explain duties toward parents, children, widows, orphans and strangers.

categories.name: Property, restitution and inheritance
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Identify ownership, restitution, boundaries and inheritance conditions.

categories.name: Economic justice
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Study lending, debt, wages, tithes and fair economic obligations.

categories.name: Agriculture and land cycles
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Study gleaning, agriculture, Sabbatical years and Jubilee.

categories.name: Priesthood, sanctuary and offerings
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Distinguish roles, offerings, sacrifices and conditional applications.

categories.name: Judges, witnesses and procedure
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Examine evidence, witnesses, jurisdiction and judicial safeguards.

categories.name: Sexual conduct and purity
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Distinguish prohibited conduct, purity conditions and procedures.

categories.name: Idolatry and prohibited practices
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Distinguish express worship restrictions from human traditions.

categories.name: Leadership and community government
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Study service, kingship, responsibility and accountability.

categories.name: Israel restoration and promised land
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Trace tribes, reunification, covenants and land inheritance.

categories.name: Prophetic judgment and Kingdom government
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Study Messiah, nations, justice, mercy, repentance and judgment.

categories.name: General scriptural foundations
categories.plannedLearningObjective: Retain historical people, places, events, wisdom and other foundations.
